 Solenis is a leading global producer of specialty chemicals focused on partnering with water\-intensive operations to solve complex water treatment, process improvement and hygiene challenges with advanced chemical and equipment solutions for consumer, industrial, institutional, food \& beverage, and recreational pool and spa water markets.
   

  

 The product portfolio of Solenis includes a broad array of water treatment chemistries, process aids, functional additives, and cleaners and disinfectants, as well as state\-of\-the\-art monitoring and control systems. These technologies are used by customers to improve operational efficiencies, enhance product quality, protect plant assets, minimize environmental impact, and create cleaner and safer environments.
   

  

 Headquartered in Wilmington, Delaware, USA, the company has 69 manufacturing facilities strategically located around the globe and employs a team of over 16,100 professionals in 130 countries across six continents. Solenis has been recognized as a Best Managed Company for 4 consecutive years and was named as 2024 Best Managed Company Gold Standard Winner.
   

  

**Position Purpose**
 The Territory Manager will be primarily responsible for meeting Key opinion leaders in hospitals (Microbiologists, infection control teams, Operations Heads) and demonstrating the company's value proposition.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Achieving monthly and annual sales target for an assigned Territory.
* Managing and developing distributor network.
* Continuously focus on sales growth execution and sales target achievement through new account research and acquisition planning, leveraging sector expertise and market intelligence.
* Take the lead initiative in developing a first\-class rapport with identified key customers/customer groups in the assigned territory.
* Gain business at targeted new accounts within pricing/margin guidelines.
* Continually evaluate key competitor activities, analyse effectiveness and prepare defensive strategic ploys.
* Develop business relationship with key decision makers to further our business interests.
* Implement with the team customer training \& education training programs
* Plan daily, weekly and annual objectives and activities to maximise customer contact and effectiveness.
* Continuously update all sales activities (e.g. funnel) using Salesforce or other CRM systems.
* Provide a monthly update to direct manager on the following:
* Tracking against KPI’s
* Plans for coming month/quarter
* Performance against previous plans
* Manage effective internal stakeholders (Customer Service, Marketing \& Finance) relationships and ability to deliver the Healthcare strategy through matrix reporting structure.
* Work closely with Application Specialists to identify and develop relevant value propositions for customers.


**Knowledge/Experience/Person Profile**
* Demonstrated Healthcare Sales Management experience.
* Demonstrated proven ability to build and nurture customer relationships
* Hygiene/sanitation experience.
* Computer literacy in Word, PowerPoint, Excel etc.
* Experience using CRM systems, such as Salesforce
* Able to demonstrate self\-management skills
* Excellent time management skills

title: Business Development Manager
description:
Founding Business Development ManagerPropTech / SaaS \| Coworking \& Managed Offices
 
**Company:** 
 Meshfloor
 



**Location:** 
 Chennai / Remote – India
 



**Experience:** 
 2–5 years
 



**Employment:** 
 Full\-time
 


 About Meshfloor
 
 Meshfloor is a SaaS platform built for coworking spaces and managed office operators.
 



 It helps operators manage their workspace operations, customers, memberships, quotations, agreements, invoicing, collections, occupancy, meeting rooms, leads and other day\-to\-day business processes from one platform.
 



 We are now looking for our
 **first dedicated sales hire** 
 to help us acquire coworking and managed\-office operators across India.
 



 This is a founding sales role. You will have significant ownership of building the sales pipeline, conducting product demonstrations, converting prospects and helping new customers get started with Meshfloor.
 


 What you will do1\. Identify potential customers
 
 Build a database of coworking and managed\-office operators across India using:
 


* LinkedIn
* Google
* Industry directories
* Real\-estate networks
* Coworking communities
* Business databases
* Direct prospecting



 Identify decision makers such as founders, owners, directors and operations heads.
 


 2\. Cold calling and outreach
 
 Contact prospects through:
 


* Phone calls
* WhatsApp
* Email
* LinkedIn
* Other appropriate B2B channels



 Understand how the operator currently manages their business and identify opportunities where Meshfloor can help.
 


 3\. Conduct product demos
 
 Schedule and conduct online product demonstrations with prospective customers.
 



 The demo should be consultative rather than simply showing product features.
 



 You should be able to understand the operator's problems and demonstrate how Meshfloor can improve areas such as:
 


* Workspace operations
* Lead management
* Customer onboarding
* Quotations
* Agreements
* Billing and invoicing
* Payment collections
* Occupancy management
* Meeting room management
* Reporting
* Multi\-location operations


 4\. Follow up and close
 
 Manage the complete sales cycle from first contact to payment.
 



 This includes:
 


* Lead qualification
* Demo scheduling
* Follow\-ups
* Proposal/quotation discussions
* Pricing discussions
* Negotiation
* Closing
* Customer handover/onboarding


 5\. Customer onboarding
 
 Assist new operators with their initial Meshfloor setup and help them start using the platform.
 



 You will work closely with the product team to understand customer requirements and communicate feedback for product improvements.
 


 Who we are looking for
 
 We are particularly interested in candidates with experience in
 **commercial real estate, coworking, managed offices or PropTech** 
 .
 



 Ideal candidates may have worked in:
 


* Coworking companies
* Managed office companies
* Commercial real estate
* Corporate office leasing
* Property management
* PropTech companies
* Real\-estate technology
* B2B SaaS companies selling to businesses


 Required skills
 * 2–5 years of sales/business development experience
* Strong cold\-calling ability
* Experience dealing with business owners or senior decision makers
* Strong communication and presentation skills
* Ability to conduct product demonstrations
* Ability to understand customer requirements and recommend solutions
* Strong follow\-up discipline
* Comfortable working with CRM systems
* Comfortable with phone, WhatsApp, email and LinkedIn outreach
* Target\-oriented and self\-driven


 Strongly preferred
 
 Experience selling to or working with:
 



**Coworking spaces \| Managed offices \| Commercial real estate \| Property management \| PropTech \| B2B SaaS** 




 Experience with SaaS products such as CRM, ERP, accounting, HRMS, property\-management or workspace\-management software will be an advantage.
 


 What we are NOT looking for
 
 This is not a traditional telecalling role.
 



 We are not looking for someone whose primary experience is simply making a high volume of calls from a predefined script.
 



 We are looking for someone who can:
 



**Find prospects → Understand their business → Conduct a demo → Sell the solution → Close the customer → Help onboard them.** 



 Compensation
 
**₹40,000–₹50,000 per month fixed** 
 , depending on experience and capability.
 



 Additional
 **performance\-based sales incentives** 
 will be provided for qualified demos, new customer acquisition and revenue generated.
 



 The final compensation will depend on experience and demonstrated sales ability.
 


 Why join Meshfloor?
 * Join at an early stage and become part of the founding sales team
* Work directly with the founder/product team
* Significant ownership and autonomy
* Opportunity to build the sales process from the ground up
* Performance\-based earning potential
* Opportunity to grow into a Sales Manager / Business Development leadership role as Meshfloor expands across India


 How to apply
 
 Please share your CV along with a brief summary of:
 


1. Your experience in real estate, coworking, managed offices, PropTech or SaaS
2. What type of products/services you have previously sold
3. Your typical sales cycle
4. Your previous sales targets and achievements
5. Why you believe you would be a good fit for selling Meshfloor


* **Shortlisted candidates will be asked to conduct a short mock sales call and Meshfloor product demonstration.**

description:
**Job Title \- Nutrition Officer/ Executive**
**Function \- Infant Nutrition**
**Location \- Calicut**
**About The Role**
 This is a field role focused on ethical engagement with Health Care Professionals (HCPs) to share scientific, evidence‑based information on infant nutrition and Nestlé’s Infant Nutrition portfolio. The role requires clear and compliant communication of product features, advantages and benefits, and their appropriate use—strictly within Nestlé’s Code of Ethics, company instructions, and the Indian Code. The role consistently upholds the principle that mother’s milk is best for babies.
   

  

**Job Description (Key Responsibilities)**
* Ethically promote Nestlé’s Infant Nutrition products to HCPs by clearly communicating product features, advantages, benefits and appropriate use, in line with company Code of Ethics and the Indian Code; reinforce that mother’s milk is best for babies.
* Ensure recommendations for the Nestlé Nutrition product range remain within the scope of the Indian Code; detail against homemade paps and bovine milk as appropriate.
* Serve as a reliable source of information on infant nutrition and infant feeding practices for HCPs.
* Plan and execute high‑quality scientific detailing, CMEs/symposiums and other scientific activities as per company guidelines.
* Map and segment HCPs in the assigned territory; develop and execute an effective coverage plan and call cycle.
* Maintain accurate records of HCP interactions, feedback, and scientific events; provide timely reports as per guidance.
* Identify opportunities and potential within the territory and contribute inputs to drive demand generation activities within compliance.
* Collaborate with internal teams to ensure availability of compliant scientific materials and support tools for field execution.


**Qualifications**
* Graduate with at least 1 year of experience in a field sales role in either a Nutrition company or the pharmaceutical industry.
* High level of integrity and honesty; hardworking, self‑motivated, and passionate about enhancing quality of life and contributing to a healthier future.
* Ability to work effectively in a team and build strong, sustainable relationships with stakeholders.
* High learning agility; trustworthy and able to work independently within company policies and guidelines.


**About Us**
 At Nestlé, our purpose is to shape a better and healthier world, inspire people to live healthier lives, and deliver impact at a scale that truly makes a difference. We believe in a diverse, supportive and collaborative culture one that encourages innovation, embraces new ideas, and empowers individuals and teams to win. We’re driven by people who are friendly, respectful and inspiring people who genuinely care about the lives we touch every single day.
   

  

**Diversity \& Inclusion**
 At Nestlé, we are committed to building an inclusive workplace where everyone feels respected, valued, and empowered to contribute. We celebrate diversity in all its forms gender, culture, abilities, backgrounds and perspectives because we believe it makes us stronger. We are dedicated to providing equal opportunities and creating an environment where people can bring their authentic selves to work and thrive.
   

  

 Learn more: https://www.nestle.in/brands/nutrition

title: Fashion Consultant
description:
**About Evoluzione** 




 Evoluzione is one of India's most respected luxury multi\-designer retail destinations, curating collections from the country's most celebrated fashion houses alongside emerging creative talent. Renowned for offering highly personalized shopping experiences, Evoluzione represents the perfect blend of craftsmanship, luxury, and contemporary Indian design.
 



 As we continue to strengthen our presence among India's most discerning clientele, we are seeking passionate fashion professionals who possess an innate sense of style, a customer\-first mindset, and a genuine appreciation for luxury fashion.
 



  





**Job Title: Fashion Consultant – Chennai** 









**The Opportunity** 




 This is an exciting opportunity to become part of one of India's premier luxury fashion destinations. As a Fashion Consultant at Evoluzione, you will play a pivotal role in creating memorable shopping experiences, building meaningful client relationships, and representing some of India's finest designers. The ideal candidate combines an eye for style with exceptional interpersonal skills and a passion for delivering world\-class service.
 



  





**Role Purpose** 




 The Fashion Consultant will be responsible for delivering an elevated customer experience, driving individual sales performance, cultivating long\-term client relationships, and serving as a trusted style advisor to Evoluzione's discerning clientele. This role requires an individual who thrives in a relationship\-driven luxury retail environment and takes pride in providing personalized fashion solutions.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  





**Sales \& Client Experience** 




 • Achieve individual sales targets and contribute to overall store performance.
 



 • Provide personalized styling advice and wardrobe recommendations to clients.
 



 • Build and maintain strong relationships with existing and prospective customers.
 



 • Conduct regular client follow\-ups to drive repeat purchases and customer loyalty.
 



 • Ensure every client receives a seamless and memorable shopping experience.
 



  





**Clienteling \& Customer Management** 




 • Develop and maintain an updated customer database.
 



 • Understand customer preferences, occasions, and purchase history to offer relevant recommendations.
 



 • Inform clients about new arrivals, designer launches, trunk shows, and special collections.
 



 • Support appointment\-based selling and personal shopping experiences.
 



  





**Product \& Merchandise Knowledge** 




 • Maintain strong knowledge of designers, collections, fabrics, craftsmanship, and seasonal trends.
 



 • Assist customers in selecting products that best suit their needs and preferences.
 



 • Ensure merchandise is displayed and presented according to store standards.
 



 • Provide feedback on customer preferences and product performance to the management team.
 



  





**Store Operations** 




 • Support daily store operations, including stock management and inventory checks.
 



 • Ensure the boutique is well\-maintained and visually appealing at all times.
 



 • Assist in handling customer queries, alterations, and order follow\-ups.
 



 • Adhere to company policies, processes, and service standards.
 



  





**Candidate Profile** 




 • 3\+ years of experience in luxury fashion, premium retail, lifestyle, beauty, hospitality, or customer\-facing sales roles.
 



 • Passion for fashion, styling, and luxury customer service.
 



 • Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
 



 • Well\-groomed, confident, and customer\-focused.
 



 • Ability to build relationships and work in a target\-driven environment.
 



 • Prior experience in designer, luxury, or premium retail will be an advantage.
 



  





**Success Measures** 




 • Achievement of individual sales targets.
 



 • Growth in repeat customers and client relationships.
 



 • Customer satisfaction and service excellence.
 



 • Product knowledge and styling capability.
 



 • Contribution to overall store performance and team objectives.
 



  





**What Evoluzione Offers** 




 • The opportunity to represent India's leading designer labels within a prestigious luxury retail environment.
 



 • Exposure to renowned designers, exclusive collections, and discerning clientele.
 



 • A collaborative, inspiring, and fashion\-forward workplace culture.

title: Partnerships & Community Associate
description:
**Location:** 

 Chennai
 




**Employment Type:** 

 Full\-time
 




**Experience:** 

 2 to 4 years
 




  





**About Wualt** 





 Wualt is building a new category at the intersection of women's safety, wellness and technology.
 





 As we move towards our product pilot and launch, we're looking for a Partnerships \& Community Associate to help build the relationships, community and momentum around the brand.
 





 This is a hands\-on role for someone who enjoys meeting people, creating opportunities and getting things done. You'll work across partnerships, community, creators, content and marketing operations, with plenty of room to take ownership and shape how Wualt grows.
 




  





**The Role** 





 As Partnerships \& Community Associate, you will be responsible for identifying and building relationships with relevant brands, communities, creators and organisations, while also supporting the day\-to\-day execution of Wualt's marketing initiatives.
 





 You'll be expected to take things from
 
**"this could be interesting" to "let's make it happen."** 




  






 This is not a traditional social media role.
 




  






 We're looking for someone who is proactive, organised, a strong communicator and comfortable working in a fast\-moving startup environment.
 




  





**What You'll Do** 




*Partnerships \& Outreach* 



* Research and identify relevant brands, communities, creators, organisations and collaboration opportunities
* Build and maintain a partnership pipeline
* Identify the right contacts and decision\-makers
* Conduct email, LinkedIn and social outreach
* Manage follow\-ups and ongoing conversations
* Schedule meetings and coordinate introductions
* Support partnership proposals and negotiations
* Coordinate agreed partnership deliverables
* Maintain relationships with existing partners
* Identify opportunities for co\-marketing, events and collaborations



  





*Community* 



* Manage Instagram DMs and community conversations
* Respond to comments and queries
* Engage with relevant communities and conversations
* Identify opportunities to introduce Wualt to new communities
* Support community initiatives and activations
* Gather audience feedback and insights
* Identify potential community advocates and brand champions
* Share recurring audience questions, feedback and objections with the wider team



  





*Creator \& UGC Coordination* 



* Research relevant creators and content creators
* Build and maintain a creator database
* Conduct creator outreach
* Coordinate briefs, timelines and deliverables
* Manage communication with creators
* Follow up on pending content
* Coordinate revisions where required
* Track content usage and deliverables
* Maintain an organised library of creator content




 You should be comfortable managing several creator conversations simultaneously and keeping projects moving without constant supervision.
 




  





*Content Operations* 





 You'll support the execution of Wualt's content calendar and production pipeline.
 





 This includes:
 



* Coordinating content shoots
* Scheduling people and locations
* Coordinating with photographers, videographers and editors
* Managing production timelines
* Organising content assets
* Maintaining the content calendar
* Coordinating approvals
* Scheduling and publishing content
* Ensuring agreed content goes live on time




 You don't need to be the person developing every creative idea, but you should be able to understand a brief and execute it accurately.
 




  





*Events \& Activations* 





 Support the planning and execution of Wualt's events and offline activations.
 





 This includes:
 



* Researching relevant events and opportunities
* Identifying potential event partners
* Outreach and coordination
* Venue and vendor coordination
* Partner communication
* Attendee coordination
* Managing event checklists and timelines
* Supporting on\-ground execution
* Coordinating post\-event follow\-ups



  





*Marketing Operations* 





 A big part of this role will be keeping things organised.
 





 You'll help manage:
 



* Marketing calendars
* Partnership trackers
* Creator databases
* Campaign trackers
* Content production timelines
* Event trackers
* Deliverables
* Follow\-ups
* Internal coordination




 You'll often be the person making sure that the right person has the right information at the right time.
 




  





**What We're Looking For** 



* Strong communication skills: You're comfortable speaking to people across email, WhatsApp, LinkedIn, Instagram and calls.
* Proactive mindset: You don't wait around for instructions when you can figure out the next step yourself.
* Excellent follow\-through: You know that sending one email isn't outreach. You follow up, keep conversations warm and close loops.
* Organisation: You can manage multiple partnerships, creators, events and content requirements without losing track.
* Resourcefulness: If one route doesn't work, you find another.
* Relationship\-building: You're naturally good at building rapport and maintaining relationships over time.
* Curiosity: You're interested in people, communities, culture, brands and why people engage with things.
* Startup mindset: You're comfortable with ambiguity, changing priorities and being involved in things outside a traditional job description.



  





**Experience** 




**2 to 4 years of relevant experience** 

 is preferred.
 





 Experience in any of the following would be valuable:
 



* Partnerships
* Community management
* Creator/influencer marketing
* Brand marketing
* Events
* Startup marketing
* D2C
* Consumer technology
* Wellness
* Lifestyle brands



  






 The exact title you've held matters less than the work you've actually done

 The Corporate Sales Tie\-Ups Manager is a full\-time, on\-site role based in Chennai.
 



  





 This position is responsible for identifying and developing corporate partnerships, managing end\-to\-end tie\-up processes, and driving revenue through strategic corporate sales initiatives. Day\-to\-day activities include prospecting and lead generation, conducting meetings and presentations with corporate clients, negotiating terms, and closing agreements that align with emHealth’s vision. The role also involves coordinating with internal teams for smooth onboarding and service delivery, and tracking sales performance through reports and dashboards. The manager is expected to collaborate closely with operations, to ensure high satisfaction and long\-term retention of corporate clients.
 



**Qualifications** 



* Strong Sales and Lead Generation skills, with experience in corporate or B2B sales environments.
* Proficiency in Account Management and Customer Service to build, nurture, and retain corporate relationships.
* Experience in Sales Operations, including pipeline management, reporting, and use of CRM tools.
* Excellent communication, presentation, and negotiation abilities.
